title: Language Model Harnesses can be Compositional Generalizers
abstract: arXiv:2611.28298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern language models (LMs) are post-trained and deployed as agents inside a "harness", but standard harness designs accumulate context that the neural network is forced to generalize to, making training for long-horizon tasks expensive and time-consuming. We study an alternative emerging path: training inherently neurosymbolic LM harnesses, which externalize and manage context programmatically to compose existing LM capabilities. We hypothesize that training around these harnesses can offer a better return on compute by enabling compositional generalization, as they can learn to decompose complex problems so that every observation their neural LM receives is locally in-distribution, even when the full task is novel. We find that harnesses like the Recursive Language Model (RLM) learn such decompositions readily under reinforcement learning post-training: (1) we demonstrate that training only on short tasks can generalize to tasks 2-6

translated_title: 语言模型框架可以成为组合泛化器
translated_abstract: 现代语言模型（LM）在“框架”内进行后训练并作为智能体部署，但标准的框架设计会不断累积上下文，迫使神经网络对其进行泛化，这使得长时程任务的训练变得昂贵且耗时。我们研究了一条新兴的替代路径：训练本质上神经符号化的语言模型框架，它们以程序化的方式外置和管理上下文，从而组合现有的语言模型能力。我们假设，围绕这些框架进行训练可以通过实现组合泛化来提供更好的计算回报，因为它们能够学会分解复杂问题，使得神经语言模型接收到的每一个观测在局部上都处于分布内，即使整个任务是全新的。我们发现，像递归语言模型（RLM）这样的框架在强化学习后训练中能够轻松学会这种分解：（1）我们证明仅在短任务上训练即可泛化到任务 2-6（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出训练神经符号化的语言模型框架（如递归语言模型RLM），通过程序化外置和管理上下文、将复杂问题分解为局部分布内的子问题来实现组合泛化，使得仅在短任务上训练的模型也能泛化到远长于训练任务的新型长时程任务。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that training neurosymbolic LM harnesses (such as the Recursive Language Model) enables compositional generalization—models trained only on short tasks can generalize to much longer novel tasks—by programmatically externalizing context and decomposing complex problems so that every observation remains locally in-distribution.
